content: Ananya Nair inquired about how to reinstate or renew her health policy HP-123456 after it expired on March 1, 2023. Vikram Singh replied that reinstatement requires payment of the outstanding premium plus a reinstatement fee, and provided a quote attachment for review, asking her to confirm if she wishes to proceed.

action_items: Customer to review attached reinstatement quote
Customer to decide whether to proceed with reinstatement
Customer to pay outstanding premium and reinstatement fee
